policy_note: This policy applies identically to every dataset listed below. It is enforced at two levels: (1) this manifest, read by scripts/guard_locked_datasets.py before any training-discovery path may include a dataset_id; (2) documentation in docs/datasets/EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_DATA.md. Neither dataset below has been downloaded — both are MISSING per data/catalog/dataset_inventory.json — so no enforcement action has been needed yet; the guard exists so that the moment either is acquired, it is protected from day one rather than added to protection later.

zenodo_part3.reason: Held-out test split defined by the Zenodo dataset's own authors. Source identity needs confirming against the exact Zenodo record ID used for Parts I/II before acquisition (see docs/datasets/EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_DATA.md).
zenodo_part3.naming_convention_guard: _LOCKED suffix on the top-level directory is a human-visible guard against accidental inclusion in a training glob, in addition to the manifest-based guard.

essd.reason: ESSD 2025 Eastern Mediterranean oil spill dataset, external to Zenodo. Requires locating the specific ESSD DOI/publication and its data availability statement first (see docs/datasets/EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_DATA.md).
